extension.description: Manage VS Code BYOK models, API keys and backups.
trust.description: Use a trusted window to edit user-level model configuration.
container.title: BYOK Manager
guide.title: BYOK Manager: Set up your first model
guide.description: Configure a provider, save a model and try it in Chat. Reading this guide changes no settings. Only the save step tracks a successful local write; no checkmark verifies provider access.
guide.provider.alt: Model list with endpoint, protocol, key status and save controls
guide.model.alt: Model editor showing the model ID, token limits and capability fields

guide.open.title: Open the model manager
guide.open.description:
Use your own provider key with VS Code Chat when the provider exposes a compatible Custom Endpoint API. GitHub sign-in may still be required by the Chat mode or organization policy. Use VS Code Desktop 1.122 or later in a trusted local window. Enable official Chat/Copilot with Custom Endpoint support. Switch to the profile where you want to use the model. Have your provider’s inference URL, API key, model ID and documented limits ready.
Select the key icon in the Activity Bar, then Open Model Manager, or use the button below. Reopen this walkthrough from the sidebar or the Command Palette with BYOK: Open User Guide.
[Open Model Manager](command:byokManager.open)
[Get started with Chat in VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/getting-started)
guide.provider.title: Set up the provider and API key
guide.provider.description:
Saved groups open on the model list. Expand Edit connection to change the endpoint or key. New groups show the connection fields immediately. Use Switch Group… to search groups, or import JSON under More. Group Name is a local label. Chat Completions accepts a message history; Responses uses a different input/output schema and may continue a previous response by ID. Choose the API your gateway actually implements (or Messages for a Messages-compatible endpoint).
Use the provider’s inference URL, not an Admin console or browser chat page. The validator accepts an absolute HTTP(S) base URL (for example, https://gateway.example/v1) or a full route; a recognized /chat/completions, /responses or /messages suffix must match the protocol. Verify the actual route with your provider. Prefer HTTPS; omit credentials, query parameters and fragments. The default fills missing model URLs. Apply to All Models replaces individual URLs in the draft.
Choose Enter API Key and enter an inference key in VS Code’s masked prompt. Only a confirmed save stores the key. If you choose Fetch Model List…, the pending key can also be sent to the destination you confirm. Without a new key, the same local group can reuse its secret reference. Choose Unauthenticated endpoint only for a service that requires no key. An Admin login does not grant model access.
guide.model.title: Add a model using its API specifications
guide.model.description:
For Responses or Chat Completions, Fetch Model List… lets you confirm the destination in VS Code before one model-list GET. Without authentication no key is sent. Otherwise discovery uses the pending key or prompts for a request-only key that is never saved. Enter keys only in native masked prompts, never in the webview. Select models for the draft and edit any unreported limits and capabilities. Listing does not test inference.
For manual entry, choose Add Model. Model ID is the exact, unique API identifier; Display Name is the picker label (blank uses the ID). Leave URL and protocol blank to inherit the group defaults.
Total Context Tokens is the combined input and output budget. Max Output Tokens caps the reply. Enter positive integers: output is required, plus total context or max input. If specified, total must exceed output; input + output must fit inside total when all three are set. Use the limits for your API deployment, not an Admin quota or web-chat allowance.
Tool Calling means structured tool requests; Vision means image input. Select them only for features supported by both model and gateway. Reasoning Capability declares support; Reasoning Effort Levels lists accepted values. Leave unknown reasoning options unspecified. These fields do not enable or detect capabilities. OK updates the draft only.
guide.auxiliary.title: Decide whether to set an auxiliary model
guide.auxiliary.description:
For a first text chat, leave Default Auxiliary Model at Keep existing model selectors. This does not choose your Chat model. Uncheck Apply recommended VS Code settings if you only want to save the model group.
With recommendations enabled, supported settings can enable Agent Host BYOK, use the main agent model for utility fallback, and queue requests. Selecting a group model additionally proposes it for four jobs: Plan Agent for planning; Inline Chat for in-editor edits; Utility for supporting tasks; Utility Small for lighter tasks.
Skip the auxiliary choice if your current defaults work or you have not checked latency, cost and capabilities. Existing user settings are preserved unless you explicitly choose Overwrite existing settings. Review proposed changes at save time.
guide.save.title: Validate, save with a backup, then try Chat
guide.save.description:
Validate checks the draft’s fields, URLs, IDs and limits locally. It does not contact the provider or test the key. Choose Save with Backup; review the profile, group, destinations, credentials and proposed settings before confirming. The manager backs up the current profile’s model file, saves the group and applies eligible settings. Saving an existing group replaces its model list.
Wait for the save result. Neither opening the manager nor confirming a dialog alone completes this step. A successful local save does not prove the endpoint works.
In a new VS Code Chat, select the specific model in your group, not Auto. Send a short text-only prompt such as “Reply with OK.” VS Code sends this request to your provider; usage may be billed. A reply tests this request, not tools, vision or every chat mode.
[Open Model Manager](command:byokManager.open)
guide.maintain.title: Maintain a group and recover a backup
guide.maintain.description:
Edit, copy or delete individual models, batch-add IDs with shared limits, or use Append JSON to merge by ID. Duplicates are skipped unless you select replacement. Review the draft, then validate and save. To rotate a key, enter its replacement for the same group; clearing a pending key does not revoke one at the provider.
Export Preset and Import JSON strip recognized credentials and all request headers. Check custom fields and endpoints before sharing. Enter credentials locally on the destination machine.
Restore Model Configuration lets you choose a backup. Confirm only if you intend to replace the entire current profile’s model file, including other providers. The manager first backs up the current file and reverts eligible settings only if unchanged since the save. Restore does not restore or delete vault entries; a missing key must be re-entered. Keep backups private.
[Choose a backup to restore](command:byokManager.restore)
guide.faq.title: Troubleshoot a failed chat or save
guide.faq.description:
401: Check the destination and re-enter a valid inference key for this group. 403: Check the key’s project, model access and provider or organization policy.
400: Compare the exact API ID, route, protocol, token budgets and optional features with the provider’s documentation. 429: Check quota, billing and concurrency; respect the provider’s retry interval.
Tools fail but text works? Verify tool support in both the model and gateway, or switch to plain chat. Context error? Shorten the history, remove attachments or lower the output budget. Raising a local limit does not raise the provider’s limit.
Responses follow-up fails? If the gateway cannot continue a previous response, try statefulResponses: false for Responses models, save, and test two turns in a new chat. Support depends on the installed provider.
Login prompt or missing model? Check the current profile, Native Model Management and selected Chat model. GitHub sign-in depends on VS Code, chat mode and policy; this extension cannot bypass sign-in or grant access.
Cannot save? Resolve unsaved or conflicting changes, reload the group, then retry. Diagnostics checks the local host, provider and commands, not network access. Share versions and a redacted error, never keys, private URLs or backups.
[Show Compatibility Diagnostics](command:byokManager.diagnose)
